task: Implement string formatting and buffer writing helpers in moss.fmt.
observation: The compiler reported 'local member calls are not implemented; use a top-level function' when calling push directly on an object field, and shadowed module-name parameter bindings.
impact: Separated the buffer Vector from the Formatter indenter struct, passing buffer explicitly to functions matching the standard moss.text builder pattern.

resolution.summary: Use top-level functions with Vector[String] buffer parameters.
